title: Human Gate Classification
description: Schema for classifying items labeled as requiring human action in next-sprint outputs.

original_label.description: The label from the next-sprint prompt (e.g., 'approval-blocked', 'blocked')

is_false_stop.description: Whether the original label was a false stop

agent_can_execute.description: Whether the agent can execute this task (even if human approval needed for release)

adjudication.description: Full Stop Reason Adjudicator output for this signal
